title: How to Find High-Probability Trend Following Setups
description:
Most traders chase momentum and get chopped up. Real trend following is about waiting for the pullback and catching the resumption.

In this tutorial, Tony Zhang shows you the simple indicators he uses to find high-quality trend following setups and how to hit home runs using options.
 
What you'll learn:
- How to identify the primary trend using 50-period CCI
- Why the 26-period EMA is key for finding healthy pullbacks
- How to find these signals automatically on OptionsPlay
- Live examples: Dollar Tree, Broadcom, AbbVie
- How to scale into positions and manage risk
- Why these trades are in and out within 2-3 weeks
